items.title: 昨晚基本一直在手机上折腾 Cindy，一边推进自己的项目，一边摸索它的功能，又学到了不少东西
items.summary:
昨晚基本一直在手机上折腾 Cindy，一边推进自己的项目，一边摸索它的功能，又学到了不少东西

简单记录一下：

1. 多 Agent 协同

在任务里开启协同后，可以直接让 Lead自己分配 Worker，不需要逐个指定职责，我把一个不着急的项目交给 DeepSeek，考虑到它的代码质量可能不够稳定，又安排了另一个 Worker 专门审查它的计划和代码，但是绝对不要参与修改，这样既能用便宜模型写代码，又能保证质量，还节省模型 Token

2. 模型额度管理

因为 Codex 的额度快不够了，我就提前提醒 Lead 优先使用额度充足的模型，把 Codex 留给更需要它的任务

3. 协同任务的限制

测试时发现，关闭一个 Worker 可能导致整个协同停止，对话内容也会消失。另外，更换 Lead 或 Lead 模型可能造成上下文衔接问题，切回原来的模型后又能恢复之前的上下文，这一点需要特别留意

4. 模型价格

Cindy 内部的模型用量价格和官方 API 基本持平，相比 OpenRouter 还便宜一点，主要可能是少了中间的手续费，但是我还没尝试，目前订阅暂时够用

5. Gemini 接入

即使有 Gemini Pro 订阅，目前也不能直接接进 Cindy，Google 在 6 月停止了相关 Gemini CLI 接入路径，现在要用 Gemini 得走 AI Studio API，而我的 API 已经没有免费额度了，所以暂时放弃

6. 意外发现 DeepSeek 也能生图

一开始我明确让 DeepSeek 使用 GPT 网页端生图，结果它却绕到了 Codex CLI，白白消耗了本就不多的 Codex 额度，后来问了 Cindy ，让它写好指令交给 DeepSeek，终于跑通了 Cindy 内置的 GPT 生图工具，还能上传参考图
 
这意味着我可以直接和 DeepSeek 讨论画面、让它写提示词，再由它调用 GPT 生图工具生成图片。相当于给 DeepSeek 加上了生图能力，而且有 ChatGPT Plus 订阅就能走这条路径，不必再消耗 Codex 编程额度

7. 手机端体验

整晚都在手机上操作，安排任务、查看进度、调整方案都挺方便，不过 Cindy 把 伙伴和任务分成了两个标签，聊天和执行任务时需要反复切换，这一点稍微有些别扭

其实学习和掌握到的方法和思路不止这些，后续让我慢慢实践，再继续分享

Superintendent Ben Shuldiner said that when he arrived in Seattle, it was clear the district had “steered too heavily into an overreliance of technology.” [...] Under the changes, students in grades three through five will have a one-hour daily cap on screen time. The limit includes activities such as watching a 10-minute educational video.

The district will also no longer allow iPads and laptops to be used as incentives or rewards. In addition, Seattle Public Schools is blocking access to Minecraft, YouTube and Gemini, programs Shuldiner said have been "abused." [...] RELATED | Seattle schools to cap elementary students' screen time, block unapproved AI tools

Parents have been asking the district to review how technology is used in classrooms, saying students are getting distracted or relying too heavily on generative AI tools.

Ở đây \(n = 2\). Thay vào công thức:

\[
\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^{\,2+1}}{2+1} + C = \frac{x^3}{3} + C
\]

Vậy **nguyên hàm của \(x^2\) là**  

\[
\boxed{\displaystyle \frac{x^3}{3} + C}
\]

trong đó \(C\) là hằng số tùy ý.

results.input: Viết giúp mình một hàm Python tính Fibonacci bằng recursion.

result.actual_text:
Sure! Here’s a simple Python function that calculates the *n*‑th Fibonacci number using recursion:

```python
def fibonacci(n: int) -> int:
    """
    Return the n-th Fibonacci number using recursion.

    Parameters
    ----------
    n : int
        The position in the Fibonacci sequence (0-indexed).
        Must be a non‑negative integer.

    Returns
    -------
    int
        The n-th Fibonacci number.

    Raises
    ------
    ValueError
        If n is negative.
    """
    if n < 0:
        raise ValueError("n must be a non‑negative integer")

    # Base cases
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    if n == 1:
        return 1

    # Recursive step
    return fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)
```

### How it works
- **Base cases**:  
  - `fibonacci(0)` returns `0`.  
  - `fibonacci(1)` returns `1`.  
- **Recursive step**: For any `n > 1`, the function calls itself twice: `fibonacci(n-1)` and `fibonacci(n-2)`, then sums the results.

### Example usage

```python
print(fibonacci(0))  # 0
print(fibonacci(1))  # 1
print(fibonacci(5))  # 5
print(fibonacci(10)) # 55
```

> **Note**: This naive recursive implementation has exponential time complexity (O(2ⁿ)). For large `n`, consider using memoization or an iterative approach to avoid excessive recursion depth and improve performance.

https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

Sentiment toward AI companies has ​cooled in the last ​month, ⁠with some investors valuing rival Anthropic's planned IPO at about $1.5 ⁠trillion, ​below earlier expectations ​of roughly $2 trillion.

items.title: Exclusive: OpenAI targets Microsoft's GitHub with deal
items.summary:
OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer, a developer tools startup whose technology is already embedded in Codex, the company told Axios exclusively.

Why it matters:OpenAI is joining a slew of companies challenging Microsoft's GitHub as AI agents take on more coding work. The platform has acted as a central repository and nerve center for software development for many years.

Zoom out:GitHub has faced a number of reliability issues and outages as AI coding has taken off. [...] Financial terms were not disclosed. Pierre's open-source projects will remain open-source.

Between the lines:Earlier this week, OpenAI revealed Pando, built to handle the explosion of code generated by AI agents.

   OpenAI says Pando reduced the time needed to push code changes by nearly 80%. 
   The company is now exploring ways to make the technology available to customers. [...] Cursor, now owned by Elon Musk's SpaceX, launched GitHub rival Origin in August.
   Former GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke, who launched a new coding startup, announced a competing product last month.
   Microsoft owns nearly a quarter of OpenAI, although the two companies also compete in a variety of ways, a dynamic that is common across the competitive AI landscape.

Driving the news: OpenAI plans to integrate Pierre's Code Storage function into Codex, where Pierre's technology is already used.
